parent_objective: design measured execution for off-track repair panel
blocked_by: need execution design before measured rollout over repair panel
supersedes: direct repair panel execution after M1722

public_gates: M1723 must design execution over the M1721 864-cell repair panel matrix without running it
M1723 must require repair variant outcome and termination aggregates
M1723 must pre-register collision/off-track repair audit thresholds
M1723 must keep task-quality repair separate from controller-family ranking
M1723 must not train replay PPO promote use private holdout or change actor inputs

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs measured execution after clean repair panel preflight audit
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: execution design only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if design omits repair variant aggregates
stop if design omits collision/off-track repair thresholds
stop if design ranks profiles directly
stop if design changes actor inputs or profile configs
fallback_plan: route to measured repair panel execution if design is accepted
route to runner repair design if existing runner cannot consume repair labels
route to branch synthesis if task-quality repair becomes underdefined
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1722 admits repair panel execution design

admission_evidence: M1722 audits the M1721 repair panel subset as clean
blocked_shortcuts: do not run environment rollout in M1723
do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1723 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: repair panel execution protocol is specified
variant aggregates and audit thresholds are specified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1723 is design-only and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design must keep L1, L2-current-tiled, L3-online, and L3-reset rows in the execution matrix
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1721 subset and M1722 audit only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If execution design cannot preserve controls and task-quality metrics, stop before execution.
allowed_claims: no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A measured execution protocol can be designed for the M1721 repair panel subset without overclaiming or changing the actor contract.
success_criteria: execution input and output artifacts are specified
repair variant outcome and termination aggregates are required
collision/off-track repair audit thresholds are specified
rollout execution training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design omits variant aggregates or repair thresholds
design changes actor inputs or profile configs
training replay PPO private holdout promotion or level3 claims occur

commands.name: design
commands.command: write off-track repair panel execution design

decision_rule: M1723 passes if it designs repair panel execution while preserving task-quality claim boundaries.
